subject: Crystal Campbell Scholarship Donation
overview: The Mustang Report featured an interview with the district's technology specialist and a recognition of students of the month. The program also included a presentation by the Medford-Malden Elks of a $2,000 scholarship donation in memory of Crystal Campbell.

items.title: Shark Skit
items.summary: Students performed a comedy sketch featuring a shark character living at the high school pool.

items.title: District Technology Specialist Interview
items.summary: District Technology Specialist Frank D'Alessio discussed his role maintaining 1,100 school computers and his background as a professional bowler.

items.title: School Updates and Weather Report
items.summary: Students presented the answer to the question of the week regarding a faculty middle name and provided a brief weather update on winter conditions.

items.title: Public Safety PSA Skit
items.summary: Students performed a dramatic public service announcement regarding the dangers of drink spiking and the importance of bystander intervention.

items.title: Crystal Campbell Scholarship Presentation
items.summary: Mayor Stephanie Muccini Burke and the Medford-Malden Elks presented a $2,000 donation to the Crystal Campbell Medford Strong Spirit Award Scholarship fund.

items.title: Student of the Month Recognition
items.summary: Principal John Perella recognized students for their achievements, including the first recipient from the carpentry department.
